# Overrides applied when compiling semgrep.txt (uv pip compile --override).
#
# mcp: semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0 (1.180.0 through 1.182.1 alike), and every mcp
# from 1.8.0 up to 1.29.x is affected by GHSA-84m7-p3x7-pcfv (unbounded session
# accumulation in the StreamableHTTP transport), fixed in 1.30.0. semgrep imports mcp
# only in its MCP server, never in `semgrep scan`, which is all semgrep.yaml runs.
# semgrep.yaml installs with --no-deps so pip does not re-apply semgrep's pin. Delete
# this line once a semgrep release allows mcp 1.30.
mcp>=1.30.0,<2

# opentelemetry: semgrep pins the OpenTelemetry family to ~=1.37.0 / ~=0.58b0, but
# opentelemetry-api <= 1.45.0 is affected by GHSA-xcq7-p3pf-p88h (unbounded tracestate
# parsing), fixed in 1.45.1. The whole family moves in lockstep (opentelemetry-sdk 1.45.1
# requires opentelemetry-api==1.45.1 and opentelemetry-semantic-conventions==0.66b1).
# semgrep uses OpenTelemetry only for its opt-in --trace export, which semgrep.yaml does not
# pass. Delete these lines once a semgrep release allows opentelemetry-api >= 1.45.1.
opentelemetry-api==1.45.1
opentelemetry-sdk==1.45.1
opentelemetry-proto==1.45.1
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-common==1.45.1
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http==1.45.1
opentelemetry-semantic-conventions==0.66b1
opentelemetry-instrumentation==0.66b1
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests==0.66b1
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading==0.66b1
opentelemetry-util-http==0.66b1
